entities.name: EMM-DEREGISTERED.NO-IMSI
entities.description: A substate of EMM-DEREGISTERED chosen when the UE has no valid subscriber data available and a cell has been selected.

entities.name: No valid subscriber data available
entities.description: Condition where SIM/USIM is not available or considered invalid by the UE.

entities.name: Cell selected
entities.description: Condition where a cell has been selected by the UE.

relations.description: The condition of no valid subscriber data guards the selection of the EMM-DEREGISTERED.NO-IMSI state.
The condition of a cell being selected guards the selection of the EMM-DEREGISTERED.NO-IMSI state.
